name: pi-kit
description: Ports SeredenFei/pi-desktop core strengths to Antigravity: Global/Project Memory with GitHub pi-memory-sync, Adaptive PlanBoard with Clean New-Window Handoff & live check-off, Goal Mode 2.0 with Git Diff stagnation circuit breaker, Thinking/Tool discipline, ~/.pi skills, and the warm minimal PI Hub side panel.
suggestedPrompts: /pi-plan 先只读梳理改动方案并列出任务看板，让我选择本窗口或新窗口净室执行
/pi-goal 启动目标模式 2.0，收敛验收标准后带独立审查与停滞熔断执行
/pi-memory 查看当前全局与项目记忆状态，并与 GitHub pi-memory-sync 同步
